final: WITH r AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, SUM(spent) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS ratio FROM budget WHERE link_to_event IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND amount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT event_id, ratio, ratio / (SELECT AVG(ratio) FROM r) AS relative FROM r ORDER BY relative DESC IS NULL, relative DESC LIMIT 10
